## load in data

We will load in an unfiltered pre-processed version of the raw data. See CzeLex_norms_preproccessing.Rmd.

```{r message=FALSE}
czlex_norming_unfiltered <- read_rds("raw_unfiltered_data/czelex_raw_unfiltered_ratings_data.rds") %>%
  mutate(value1 = ifelse(value == "unknown", NA, as.numeric(value)),
         value_known = ifelse(is.na(value1), 0, 1)
         )

czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics <- read_rds("raw_unfiltered_data/czelex_raw_unfiltered_demographic_data.rds")

```

Store the starting n rows and n participants.

```{r}
n_start <- czlex_norming_unfiltered %>%
  nrow()

n_ppt_start <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics %>%
  nrow()

n_items_start <- czlex_norming_unfiltered %>%
  summarise(n_items = n_distinct(name))

n_start
n_ppt_start
n_items_start$n_items

```

## Filtering step 1: Native speakers

We will first remove any participants who did not report being native Czech speakers.

```{r}
czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_czech <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics %>%
  filter(language == "Czech")

czlex_norming_unfiltered_czech <- czlex_norming_unfiltered %>%
  filter(subject %in% czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_czech$subject)

czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_notczech <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics %>%
  filter(language != "Czech")

czlex_norming_unfiltered_notczech <- czlex_norming_unfiltered %>%
  filter(!subject %in% czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_czech$subject)

#n rows lost
n_lost_step_1 <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_notczech %>%
  nrow()

#n participants lost
n_ppts_lost_step_1 <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_notczech %>%
  nrow()

cat("N rows lost: ", n_lost_step_1, "\n")
cat("N ppts lost: ", n_ppts_lost_step_1, "\n")
cat("N rows: ", czlex_norming_unfiltered_czech %>%
      nrow(), "\n")
cat("N ppts: ",czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_czech %>%
      nrow(), "\n")

```

## Filtering step 2: Age

We will remove any participants under 18, note this is likely due to a typo as the sample should have been university participants.

```{r}
czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_age <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_czech %>%
  filter(age >= 18)

czlex_norming_unfiltered_age <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_czech %>%
  filter(subject %in% czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_age$subject)

czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_notage <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_czech %>%
  filter(age < 18)

czlex_norming_unfiltered_notage <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_czech %>%
  filter(!subject %in% czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_age$subject)

#n rows lost
n_lost_step_2 <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_notage %>%
  nrow()

#n participants lost
n_ppts_lost_step_2 <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_notage %>%
  nrow()

cat("N rows lost: ", n_lost_step_2, "\n")
cat("N ppts lost: ", n_ppts_lost_step_2, "\n")
cat("N rows: ", czlex_norming_unfiltered_age %>%
      nrow(), "\n")
cat("N ppts: ",czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_age %>%
      nrow(), "\n")

```

## Filtering step 3: Word knowledge

We will remove any participants who had a proportion known across the items that was less than 80%, as this would not be indicative of the majority of the population being sampled, which was around 96%.

```{r}
czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_known1 <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_age %>%
  left_join(czlex_norming_unfiltered_age %>%
              group_by(subject, dimension) %>%
              summarise(prop_known = mean(value_known)) %>%
              ungroup()
              ) %>%
  mutate(subject_dimension = paste0(subject, "_", dimension),
         mean_prop_known = mean(prop_known)) %>%
  filter(prop_known >= 0.75)

czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_known <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_known1 %>%
  select(-subject_dimension) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = dimension, values_from = prop_known, names_prefix = "prop_known_")

czlex_norming_unfiltered_known <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_age %>%
  mutate(subject_dimension = paste0(subject, "_", dimension)) %>%
  filter(subject_dimension %in% czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_known1$subject_dimension)

czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_notknown1 <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_age %>%
  left_join(czlex_norming_unfiltered_age %>%
              group_by(subject, dimension) %>%
              summarise(prop_known = mean(value_known)) %>%
              ungroup()
              ) %>%
  mutate(subject_dimension = paste0(subject, "_", dimension)) %>%
  filter(prop_known < 0.75)

czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_notknown <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_notknown1 %>%
  select(-subject_dimension) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = dimension, values_from = prop_known, names_prefix = "prop_known_")

czlex_norming_unfiltered_notknown <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_age %>%
  mutate(subject_dimension = paste0(subject, "_", dimension)) %>%
  filter(!subject_dimension %in% czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_known1$subject_dimension)

#n rows lost
n_lost_step_3 <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_notknown %>%
  nrow()

#n participants lost
n_ppts_lost_step_3 <- nrow(czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_age) - nrow(czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_known)

n_ppts_affected_step_3 <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_notknown %>%
  nrow()

cat("N rows lost: ", n_lost_step_3, "\n")
cat("N ppts lost: ", n_ppts_lost_step_3, "\n")
cat("N ppts affected: ", n_ppts_affected_step_3, "\n")
cat("N rows: ", czlex_norming_unfiltered_known %>%
      nrow(), "\n")
cat("N ppts: ",czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_known %>%
      nrow(), "\n")

```

## Filtering step 4: Straightlining

We will remove data from any participant who provided the same response on the rating scale for more than 95% of the items. This will be done based on individual dimensions,e.g. if a participant responded to all of the items with the neautral mid-point for valence, their data for valence will be removed.

```{r}
czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_straightlining1 <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_known %>%
  group_by(subject, dimension, value) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(subject, dimension) %>%
  mutate(n_values = n(),
         sum = sum(n),
         prop = n/sum) %>%
  mutate(subject_dimension = paste0(subject, "_", dimension)) %>%
  slice_max(prop) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(subject, dimension, subject_dimension, prop) %>%
  filter(prop <= 0.95)

czlex_norming_unfiltered_straightlining <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_known %>%
  mutate(subject_dimension = paste0(subject, "_", dimension)) %>%
  filter(subject_dimension %in% czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_straightlining1$subject_dimension)

czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_straightlining <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_known %>%
  filter(subject %in% czlex_norming_unfiltered_straightlining$subject)

czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_notstraightlining1 <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_known %>%
  group_by(subject, dimension, value) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(subject, dimension) %>%
  mutate(n_values = n(),
         sum = sum(n),
         prop = n/sum) %>%
  mutate(subject_dimension = paste0(subject, "_", dimension)) %>%
  slice_max(prop) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(subject, dimension, subject_dimension, prop) %>%
  filter(prop > 0.95)

czlex_norming_unfiltered_notstraightlining <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_known %>%
  mutate(subject_dimension = paste0(subject, "_", dimension)) %>%
  filter(subject_dimension %in% czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_notstraightlining1$subject_dimension)

czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_notstraightlining <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_known %>%
  filter(subject %in% czlex_norming_unfiltered_notstraightlining$subject)

#n rows lost
n_lost_step_4 <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_notstraightlining %>%
  nrow()

#n participants lost
n_ppts_lost_step_4 <- nrow(czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_known) - nrow(czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_straightlining)

n_ppts_affected_step_4 <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_notstraightlining %>%
  nrow()

cat("N rows lost: ", n_lost_step_4, "\n")
cat("N ppts lost: ", n_ppts_lost_step_4, "\n")
cat("N ppts affected: ", n_ppts_affected_step_4, "\n")
cat("N rows: ", czlex_norming_unfiltered_straightlining %>%
      nrow(), "\n")
cat("N ppts: ",czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_straightlining %>%
      nrow(), "\n")

```

## Filtering step 5: Calibrator items

We will remove data from any participant who responds in an 'opposite' way for the calibrator and control items within a dimension, e.g. if they respond to the item 'happy' as negative and 'bully' as positive for valence. This is done based on the participant's responses to that dimension, not across all of their data.

```{r}
calibrator_words <- tibble(dimension = c(rep("aoa", 2), rep("concreteness", 2), rep("gender", 2), rep("imageability", 2), rep("valence", 2)),
                            name = c("pejsek", "federalismus", "teorie", "neoliberalismus", "náhrdelník", "otec", "orel", "chipsy", "šikanovat", "štěstí"),
                           calibrator_control = rep(0:1, 5),
                           value_min = c(0, 5, 1, 1, 0, -3, 4, 4, -3, 0),
                           value_max = c(5, 40, 5, 5, 3, 0, 7, 7, 0, 3),
                           calibrator = rep(TRUE, 10))

czlex_norming_unfiltered_calibrator1 <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_straightlining %>%
  left_join(calibrator_words) %>%
  filter(calibrator == TRUE) %>%
  mutate(value_odd = ifelse(value1 < value_min | value1 > value_max, 1, 0)) %>%
  filter(value_odd == 1) %>%
  group_by(subject, dimension) %>%
  count() %>%
  filter(n > 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(subject_dimension = paste0(subject, "_", dimension))

czlex_norming_unfiltered_calibrator <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_straightlining %>%
  filter(!subject_dimension %in% czlex_norming_unfiltered_calibrator1$subject_dimension)

czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_calibrator <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_straightlining %>%
  filter(subject %in% czlex_norming_unfiltered_calibrator$subject)

czlex_norming_unfiltered_notcalibrator <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_straightlining %>%
  filter(subject_dimension %in% czlex_norming_unfiltered_calibrator1$subject_dimension)

czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_notcalibrator <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_straightlining %>%
  filter(subject %in% czlex_norming_unfiltered_notcalibrator$subject)

#n rows lost
n_lost_step_5 <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_notcalibrator %>%
  nrow()

#n participants lost
n_ppts_lost_step_5 <- nrow(czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_straightlining) - nrow(czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_calibrator)

n_ppts_affected_step_5 <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_notcalibrator %>%
  nrow()

cat("N rows lost: ", n_lost_step_5, "\n")
cat("N ppts lost: ", n_ppts_lost_step_5, "\n")
cat("N ppts affected: ", n_ppts_affected_step_5, "\n")
cat("N rows: ", czlex_norming_unfiltered_calibrator %>%
      nrow(), "\n")
cat("N ppts: ",czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_calibrator %>%
      nrow(), "\n")

```

## Filtering step 6: AoA data

As the AoA data required a numeric response, there was the possibility that some responses were errors. We filtered this data on the following basis:

- If a participant responded with an AoA value higher than their reported age, it would be removed at the item level.
- If a participant responded with an AoA value that was smaller than 0, i.e. negative, it would be removed at the item level.
- If a participant had more than 10 items that were affected by the above two conditions, all of their AoA data would be removed.

```{r}
czlex_norming_unfiltered_aoa1 <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_calibrator %>%
  left_join(czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_calibrator %>%
              select(subject, age)) %>%
  mutate(aoa_outlier = ifelse(is.na(value1), 0,
                              ifelse(dimension == "aoa" & value1 > age, 1, 0)),
         aoa_outlier1 = ifelse(is.na(value1), 0,
                               ifelse(dimension == "aoa" & value1 < 0, 1, 0)),
         aoa_outlier2 = ifelse(aoa_outlier == 1 | aoa_outlier1 == 1, 1, 0)) %>%
  group_by(subject, dimension) %>%
  mutate(n_outlier = sum(aoa_outlier2))

czlex_norming_unfiltered_aoa2 <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_aoa1 %>%
  filter(n_outlier > 10) %>%
  distinct(subject, dimension, subject_dimension, n_outlier)

czlex_norming_unfiltered_aoa <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_calibrator %>%
  left_join(czlex_norming_unfiltered_aoa1) %>%
  filter(!subject_dimension %in% czlex_norming_unfiltered_aoa2$subject_dimension,
         aoa_outlier2 == 0) %>%
  select(-age:-n_outlier)

czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_aoa <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_calibrator %>%
  filter(subject %in% czlex_norming_unfiltered_aoa$subject)

czlex_norming_unfiltered_notaoa <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_calibrator %>%
  left_join(czlex_norming_unfiltered_aoa1) %>%
  filter(subject_dimension %in% czlex_norming_unfiltered_aoa2$subject_dimension | aoa_outlier2 != 0)

czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_notaoa <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_calibrator %>%
  filter(subject %in% czlex_norming_unfiltered_notaoa$subject)

#n rows lost
n_lost_step_6 <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_notaoa %>%
  nrow()

#n participants lost
n_ppts_lost_step_6 <- nrow(czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_calibrator) - nrow(czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_aoa)

n_ppts_affected_step_6 <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_notaoa %>%
  nrow()

cat("N rows lost: ", n_lost_step_6, "\n")
cat("N ppts lost: ", n_ppts_lost_step_6, "\n")
cat("N ppts affected: ", n_ppts_affected_step_6, "\n")
cat("N rows: ", czlex_norming_unfiltered_aoa %>%
      nrow(), "\n")
cat("N ppts: ",czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_aoa %>%
      nrow(), "\n")

```

## Filtering step 7: Low N responses

We removed data at the item level if the number of participants who provided a rating, i.e. did not choose unknown for the item, was less than 10. This was done on the basis of each individual dimension.

```{r}
czlex_norming_unfiltered_low1 <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_aoa %>%
  mutate(name_dimension = paste0(name, "_", dimension)) %>%
  left_join(czlex_norming_unfiltered_aoa %>%
              group_by(name, dimension) %>%
              summarise(n_ratings = n(),
                        n_known_ratings = sum(value_known)) %>%
              mutate(name_dimension = paste0(name, "_", dimension)) %>%
              ungroup())

czlex_norming_unfiltered_low <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_low1 %>%
  filter(n_known_ratings >= 10)

czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_low <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_aoa %>%
  filter(subject %in% czlex_norming_unfiltered_low$subject)

czlex_norming_unfiltered_notlow <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_low1 %>%
  filter(n_known_ratings < 10)

czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_notlow <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_aoa %>%
  filter(!subject %in% czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_low$subject)

#n rows lost
n_lost_step_7 <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_notlow %>%
  nrow()

#n participants lost
n_ppts_lost_step_7 <- nrow(czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_aoa) - nrow(czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_low)

n_items_affected_step_7 <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_notlow %>%
  distinct(name) %>%
  nrow()

cat("N rows lost: ", n_lost_step_7, "\n")
cat("N ppts lost: ", n_ppts_lost_step_7, "\n")
cat("N items affected: ", n_items_affected_step_7, "\n")
cat("N rows: ", czlex_norming_unfiltered_low %>%
      nrow(), "\n")
cat("N ppts: ",czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_low %>%
      nrow(), "\n")

```

## Final data

```{r}
czlex_norming_filtered <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_low %>%
  select(subject:value_known)

czlex_norming_filtered_demographics <- czlex_norming_unfiltered_demographics_low %>%
  select(subject:gender_scale)

cat("N rows: ", czlex_norming_filtered %>%
      nrow(), "\n")
cat("N ppts: ", czlex_norming_filtered_demographics %>%
      nrow(), "\n")
cat("N items: ", czlex_norming_filtered %>%
      distinct(name) %>%
      nrow(), "\n")

```

## Save the data

We will now export the data so it can be used for filtering.

```{r}
write_excel_csv(czlex_norming_filtered, "raw_filtered_data/czelex_raw_filtered_ratings_data.csv")
saveRDS(czlex_norming_filtered, "raw_filtered_data/czelex_raw_filtered_ratings_data.rds")

write_excel_csv(czlex_norming_filtered_demographics, "raw_filtered_data/czelex_raw_filtered_demographic_data.csv")
saveRDS(czlex_norming_filtered_demographics, "raw_filtered_data/czelex_raw_filtered_demographic_data.rds")

```
